messages:
maria (AE): Heads-up — customer POC (tenant 12345) seeing spikes of 429s overnight. They run embeddings + chat in parallel and hit failures when load ramps.
vikram (SalesEng): Can you paste the exact client error & sample request? Need to see headers + which model routes.
maria (AE): Pasting their snippet (redacted API key):
```
curl -X POST 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED" 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/engines/llama-2/generate 
  -d '{"input":"...","max_tokens":512}'

HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
{"error":"rate_limit_exceeded: per-route token budget"}
```
They also call /v1/embeddings in separate threads at the same time.
ian (SRE): Looks like the per-route token window is being exhausted. Embeddings/encode calls burn a lot of input tokens even before generation. For this tenant I see a steady 6 reqs/s burst for 10m windows.
vikram (SalesEng): Is this the default per-route cap or a tenant override? Customer on trial; we haven't applied Dedicated for them.
ian (SRE): Default per-route config for hosted tier: 120 reqs/min and a token_budget window of 300s with a soft token limit. But token accounting can still hit an early 429 if many long inputs + embeddings concurrently. In this case embeddings + generate are hitting the same route namespace (both under /v1/models/llama-2) so they share the budget.
ian (SRE): Quick mitigation options:
- Route embeddings to the embeddings-specific model endpoint (separate route) to avoid shared per-route tokens.
- Temporarily increase the per-route token budget for tenant 12345 while POC runs.
- Batch embedding calls on the client side.
- Short-term: reduce max_tokens on generate to cut output token usage.
vikram (SalesEng): Customer prefers no code changes; they'd rather we bump something on our side for the demo window. Can SRE open a temp quota increase?
alex (Billing): For trial tenants we can approve short quota bumps up to X for sales demos. Need SE + AE approval and a ticket created. Also note that billing must log any overages.
ian (SRE): I can apply a 2-hr temporary bump. Command I will run (internal admin only):
```
POST https://internal-api.redwood.ai/admin/tenants/12345/quota
Authorization: Bearer ADMIN_REDACTED
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "route": "/v1/models/llama-2",
  "per_min": 400,
  "token_budget": 500000,
  "window_seconds": 300,
  "expires_in_seconds": 7200
}
```
(This increases per-minute requests and token budget for that route.)
sre-bot: Change request received: ticket #INC-2026 created, applied temp quota for tenant 12345 on /v1/models/llama-2 (+test mode). Monitoring link: https://console.redwood.ai/monitors/INC-2026
maria (AE): Thanks — I'll tell the customer and re-run their POC tests in 10 mins.
vikram (SalesEng): Please confirm whether embeddings will still hit a shared route — if so we should route embeddings to /v1/embeddings-model for future POCs to avoid repeated ticketing.
ian (SRE): Agree. We'll add a note in the POC checklist: separate embeddings route or batching. I've also pinned a short doc in the ticket with recommended client config and a sample request that uses the embeddings endpoint.
eng-oncall: Added an alert to escalate if 429 rate > 5% for more than 5 minutes after the change. Will follow up if it persists.
maria (AE): Customer ran their test — initial report: errors dropped to 0 after bump. Will keep them on the call for the remaining hour. :thumbsup:
notes: thread about temporary quota bump and per-route token budgeting for POC; includes admin payload and monitor link
